description: Stuw is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Vaste of beweegbare constructie die dient om het peil bovenstrooms van de constructie te verhogen c.q. te regelen. bron: Aquo. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2025-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
